name: Shaanxi Fenghuo Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shaanxi Fenghuo Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research, production, and sale of communication, radar, and electroacoustic equipment in China. The company offers aviation search and rescue positioning equipment, in-vehicle audio control systems, radio altimeters, and doppler ultrasounds.
